rows.en:
(I came to the simulator
with Yuuto today.)

\p,
let's go at it as a team today.

Yeah, sure.
Combination practice, right?

Let's show them the power
of our friendship!
I'm glad that went well.
Of course it did!

But our finish is still sloppy...
We should be able to do even better...
So let's go again!
Roger!

(I came to the simulator
with Kagura-kun today.)

Yeah, sure.
Combination practice, right?
I'm glad that went well.

\p,
mind if we check our teamwork
again today?

Yeah, sure.
It's hard to practice that unless
we're both here.
All right, here we go!!
That was perfect, huh.

Yeah. That's the first flight I've been
happy with in a while.
But we should be able to do even better...

Yeah, let's try as many times
as it takes!

(I came to the simulator
with Kagura-kun again today.)

Yes, of course.
It's hard to practice that unless
we're both here.
That was perfect!

(I was planning to hang out at Folmo
with Yuuto today...)
Sorry I'm late, Yuuto!
Nah, actually, I was running late too...

What, really...?
Then I apologized for nothing!
"For nothing"...?

Have some soft serve or something
and cheer up.
The soft serve here is superb.
So you like this soft serve too, Yuuto.

Yeah. I hate milk,
but I can eat this.
You're as picky as ever...

(I'm supposed to hang out at Folmo
with Kagura-kun today...)
Sorry I'm late, Kagura-kun!

What's that supposed to mean~?
Then I apologized for nothing!

Do you like this soft serve too,
Kagura-kun?
You're as picky as ever...

(I came to Folmo with Yuuto
again today.)
What should we do today?

Hmm, how about we go see
the hippo-cows?
Yeah, let's go see them!!
Whoa, they're bigger than I expected.

I wonder how much milk
you can get from just one?

Who knows...
I don't even know how much you get
from a regular cow...
Now that you mention it, that's true...
Hmm, shall we go get some soft serve...?

(I came to Folmo with Kagura-kun
again today.)

I wonder how much milk
you can get from just one?
Now that you mention it, that's true...

(Sometimes I just get this craving
for Nyan-Nyan's Galaxy Ramen.)

(Aah~ Just thinking about it
is making me hungry...)

You look like you're about to drool
any second. How unbecoming!
Ah, sorry...
Wait, huh? Klan-senpai, it's you!

Are you here to eat at Nyan-Nyan too,
young man?

Yes.
I was just dying for some Galaxy Ramen.

Very well! Then as your senpai,
it's my duty to treat you!
Huh?! N-no, I couldn't let you do that...

Don't worry about it.
This much is only natural.
Klan-senpai...

Then I'll gladly take you up on it.
Thanks for the treat!
Mm. Then let's go.

(Treating me to a meal...
That's Klan-senpai for you.)

Here you are, one Galaxy Ramen.
Sorry for the wait!
Here it comes!
Thanks for the foooood!!
(The aroma of this hippo-cow broth...)
*Slurp slurp*

(And the Magellan fishcake swirls,
of course...)
*Sluuurp*...... Pwah~!

(But the chashu pork is still the part
I look forward to mo......)
Don't mind if I do~!
Huh?!
The chashu is melting in my mouth~...

Why are you eating my chashu
without asking?!
Klan-senpai!

It was right in front of me,
so I just couldn't help myself!

Come on...
That's so mean, Klan-senpai......
Heh, sorry, sorry.

"Sorry, sorry"? Apologizing that lightly
doesn't exactly......

uncertain: c07659 'ryoukai!' is used 28 times (player in friendship, Sports Day/festival/test scenes); 'Roger!' fits all, as c07535 'Roger!!'.
c07705: Klan calls the male player shounen; rendered 'young man', as c08263 in a finished slice.

c07719: Magellan naruto (the fishcake slice with a swirl, named after the Magellanic Clouds) rendered 'the Magellan fishcake swirls'; c07721/c07724/c07726 chaashuu rendered 'chashu pork' / 'chashu'. Not in the glossary; Galaxy Ramen follows the finished slices.

c07716 itadakimasu stretched by Klan rendered 'Thanks for the foooood!!' (finished slices use 'Thanks for the food!'); c07722 itadaki~ (her grabbing the player's chashu) rendered 'Don't mind if I do~!'.
c07657 tsume ga amai rendered 'our finish is still sloppy'; Kagura includes himself (he is speaking of their combination flight).
c07676/c07685 ayamari-zon (an apology wasted) rendered 'Then I apologized for nothing!'; c07677 echoes it.
c07702 darashinai from Klan rendered 'How unbecoming!' to fit her stiff, bossy voice (finished slices use 'pathetic' for other speakers).
c07730 trails off in the Japanese; kept unfinished.
missing_glossary: Magellan naruto (c07719) and chaashuu (c07721) are not in the glossary (food items, rendered descriptively).
